verdict.rationale: An identity verification API platform could plausibly ship an official CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only a REST API, SDKs, webhooks, no-code Workflow Studio, Smart Capture Link and an llms.txt file, with no mention of a command-line tool. Those are adjacent building blocks or other features and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
